content.title: Flat Recomposition | Geometric Rhythm Brand Film
content.summary: Stable silhouettes and geometric motifs are repeatedly dismantled and reassembled. After the high-density phase, they briefly pause and resolve into existing graphic families.

quick_start.input_format: Single geometric motif + stable silhouette + repeated disassembly and reassembly + high-density phase + short pause + resolution of existing graphics
quick_start.recommended_input: Using the coral spiral as the sole motif, a stable submarine silhouette runs throughout; the spiral is repeatedly broken down into sonar arcs and route maps, briefly pauses after the high-density data phase, and is finally reassembled into the emblem of the same graphic family.
required_anchors: Disassembly and reassembly occur multiple times
After the high density, a short pause is left, and it is resolved using existing graphics.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Stable silhouettes and geometric motifs were repeatedly dismantled and reorganized. After the high-density stage, they paused briefly and converged into existing graphic families.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Build a flat poster world around one dominant geometric motif and one stable protagonist silhouette. Repeatedly fracture and reconstruct the layout through hard-edged crops, diagrams, negative space and key states; reserve continuous physical action, then slow briefly for a contrastive operational tableau and resolve all graphic families into one closing system. Motif, palette, subject class, icon family, tempo, contrast state and final graphic outcome are variable.

invariants.rule: Establish one dominant geometric motif and protagonist silhouette immediately.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without anchors, rapid recomposition becomes random collage.

invariants.rule: Keep all space flat and poster-like while graphic planes transform.
invariants.ablation_failure: Realistic 3D depth breaks the visual system.

invariants.rule: Use key states and symbolic environmental inserts instead of continuous combat.
invariants.purpose: Lets composition carry motion and preserves readability.
invariants.ablation_failure: Full action choreography competes with graphic transitions.

invariants.rule: Peak information density before a short contrastive operational tableau.
invariants.purpose: Creates a clear acceleration and breath without requiring a rival character.
invariants.ablation_failure: Uniform density removes rhythm and makes the operational state unreadable.

invariants.rule: Resolve the established graphic families into one original closing system.
invariants.purpose: Converts montage energy into a memorable endpoint.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated logo or fade fails to resolve the system.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original subject whose identity and silhouette remain stable.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One readable variable that changes monotonically or in countable stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: One restrained performance rule that makes the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A coherent information order that does not copy the source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: One clean physical or graphic consequence that closes the causal chain.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: A new hierarchy of diegetic cues supporting each state change.

anti_copy_exclusions: giant purple lunar eclipse and lunar phase diagrams
gray-haired villain in a wide-brim black hat
source purple-black-silver palette, raven inserts and exact astrology UI

instantiations.concept: An underwater research PV uses a coral spiral motif, autonomous submersible silhouette, sonar wedges and ink-black fish schools; it alternates environmental scale shifts with tool-free navigation states, pauses on an empty pressure gate, then resolves into a shell-current navigation emblem.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Flat coral-poster research sequence with machine navigation states, environmental inserts, an unoccupied gate tableau and shell-current resolution.

instantiations.concept: A weather-station ident centers a wind-rosette motif, sensor-mast silhouette and pressure maps, slows on an empty storm shutter state, then resolves into a route-bearing forecast system.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Editorial atmosphere geometry driven by machine state and an unoccupied operational tableau.

instantiations.concept: A logistics explainer centers a folded-corridor motif, autonomous carrier silhouette and parcel-flow diagrams, slows on an empty checkpoint gate and resolves into a path-status symbol.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Flat operational motion graphics with no character rivalry or weapon-like insert.

failure_modes.repair: Use flat planes, hard shadows, graphic crops and no volumetric perspective.
Reduce movement to a few iconic key poses and let layout transitions carry energy.

failure_modes.failure: The final mark introduces unrelated graphics.
failure_modes.repair: Build it only from motif, grid and icon families already established.
